Any downstream adaptive implementation that treats pitch, depth, epsilon, timeout or unresolved cells as truth invalidates the primary selection boundary.
Any exact-cell control sharing the primary classifier/material representation or being used outside proved semialgebraic admission invalidates challenger independence.
Any promotion of directional, mesh or sparse representations to canonical authority, or backend component identity to durable body/lineage, invalidates the selected architecture.
Any change to the MC-049 frozen generator/record denominator requires a new reviewed freeze identity; failures may not be removed by editing the historical selection evidence.
Future blocker resolution or native qualification may strengthen the route prospectively but must preserve all negative candidate evidence and producing identities.
